**The fix:** when the server rejected a field (400 with `fieldErrors`), the add/edit task dialog kept the message but never showed it. The field still counted as valid on the client side, and the error label only appears for invalid fields. In `frontend/src/app/features/tasks/task-form-dialog.component.ts` I added 4 lines that mark each rejected field invalid. I re-ran that browser test and `ng build`; the message now shows under the Title field. To reach the server check from the browser I had to switch off the page's own validation temporarily, because it normally blocks bad input before it is sent.

The headless permissions blocked a shell command that used variables, so I created the browser test data with requests from inside the page instead. Screenshots are in `run-artifacts/playwright/verify-M02-r1/`, because copying them out of that folder is not allowed.

Small issues I noted but did not turn into fix tasks:
- The "Complete" button still shows on tasks that are already done. Clicking it again does nothing harmful.
- `GET /api/tasks` returns 400 for an invalid filter value, which the contract does not list for that operation.

I stopped and restarted the backend on port 8090 for the error-state test; it is running again and kept its data. I wrote the report, evidence, progress log entry and handoff, and `verdict.json` last.
